caption.zh: 白鸽舒展双翼，掠过聚集着鸽群的屋檐。
caption.en: A white pigeon spreads its wings above an eave where other pigeons gather.

alt.zh: 蓝天下一只白鸽飞起，右侧屋檐上停着一群白鸽。
alt.en: A white pigeon in flight against a blue sky, with a group of pigeons resting on the eave to the right.

caption.zh: 柔焦的绿意间，浅粉色花朵沿枝条展开。
caption.en: Pale pink blossoms trace the branches against a softly blurred green background.

alt.zh: 细长枝条上开着浅粉色花朵，背景是一片虚化的绿色。
alt.en: Pale pink flowers on slender branches, with a blurred green background.

caption.zh: 层叠的屋檐和装饰构件，在蓝天之下形成起伏的线条。
caption.en: Layered eaves and ornamental details form rising and falling lines beneath the blue sky.

alt.zh: 蓝天下层叠的传统建筑屋檐，带有黄色琉璃瓦和屋脊装饰。
alt.en: Overlapping traditional rooflines with yellow glazed tiles and ridge ornaments beneath a blue sky.

caption.zh: 花枝在前，桥上的行人与水面在后。
caption.en: Flowering branches in the foreground; people on a bridge and the water beyond.

alt.zh: 浅粉色花枝伸向画面中央，后方桥上有几位虚焦的行人。
alt.en: Pale pink flowering branches reach into the frame, with softly blurred people on a bridge behind them.

caption.zh: 临水亭台被树影环绕，水面泛起浅色波纹。
caption.en: A waterside pavilion framed by trees, with pale ripples across the water.

alt.zh: 黄色屋顶的中式亭台临水而立，前景水面呈蓝绿色并泛起波纹。
alt.en: A Chinese pavilion with a yellow tiled roof beside rippling blue-green water.

caption.zh: 日光照进窗边，青花器物与茶席停在明暗之间。
caption.en: Window light falls across blue-and-white ceramics and a tea setting.

alt.zh: 窗边的茶席摆有青花瓷器、木架和茶具，阳光斜照在桌面上。
alt.en: Blue-and-white porcelain, a wooden display stand, and tea utensils arranged beside a sunlit window.

caption.zh: 红色旗帜、黄色灯笼与屋顶上的身影，构成街巷的一瞬。
caption.en: A red flag, yellow lanterns, and a figure above the roofline mark a moment in the street.

alt.zh: 蓝天下，一人在传统建筑屋顶边举起红色旗帜，檐下挂着黄色灯笼。
alt.en: A person raises a red flag above a traditional roofline under a blue sky, with yellow lanterns below the eaves.

caption.zh: 蓝红舞台灯光中，手持话筒的身影与乐器交叠。
caption.en: A figure holding a microphone and musical instruments overlap in blue and red stage light.

alt.zh: 现场演出的舞台上，一位表演者手持话筒，周围是蓝红色灯光和乐器。
alt.en: A performer holding a microphone on a live stage surrounded by blue and red lighting and instruments.
